name: C++ Win32 host + WebView2 (evergreen runtime, static loader) + md4c-html

variants.notes: best honest cold start: env+controller started first on a parking HWND, md4c on a worker thread, first ~24 KB of HTML via NavigateToString, rest appended by postMessage after the first frame; browser args: --disable-gpu --in-process-gpu NetworkServiceInProcess + disabled background features; persistent UDF in %LOCALAPPDATA%

untuned WebView2 reference: no environment/controller options, no browser args, GPU process on, whole document in one page (NavigateToString, >1.5 MB via WebResourceRequested). Host-side tricks are still on (controller started on a parking HWND before the window, md4c on a worker thread), so this is 'stock WebView2 settings', not the plain Microsoft sample

RESIDENT (PROTOCOL 6): pre-started fastmd-wv2.exe --resident keeps the environment + a hidden controller with the shell page; fastmd-open.exe forwards path + FASTMD_BENCH_* via WM_COPYDATA; document goes in by PostWebMessageAsString; GPU compositing on
